clarifications: Net force and constant positive mass/inertial-frame assumptions are explicit.
Action/reaction forces act on different bodies, not two cancellable arrows in one body diagram.
A rigid body can have relative centripetal acceleration while internal force pairs cancel in center-of-mass translation.
Coulomb coefficients depend on material pair and conditions. The contradictory wet-concrete/rubber table row is not selected as a production constant.
A conveyor can accelerate a block via friction: kinetic friction opposes relative contact velocity, not necessarily world velocity.
N=mg or mgcosθ is conditional; support acceleration and other normal forces change N.
Historical9.796 equatorial model and rounded G are not exact Earth measurements.
Jump design examples describe declared toy equations, not proprietary named-game code.
Avoid rigid-body variable-mass and fully relativistic extrapolations of F=ma.
